title: The move into done moves earlier archived sessions into the vault, a silent loss where knowledge is not committed (#165)
symptom: Advancing a session from accept to done removed an earlier archived session file from .chough/sessions/archive/ with no ledger entry.
trigger: chough stage advance from accept to done with more than five archived sessions and the librarian on, in a project whose knowledge/ directory is not committed.
expected: Every earlier archived session file stays in place byte for byte; done adds only the advancing session's own archive (KNOW-34, REQ-history-006).
actual: The KNOW-29 roll-up keeps the five newest archived sessions and moves the rest into knowledge/attachments/<key>/sessions/; where knowledge/ is not committed, Git sees the earlier archived sessions as deleted (algochat release-0-7-0, 2026-11-10; GitHub #165).
steps: Create a session and write seven earlier archived sessions under .chough/sessions/archive/, leaving knowledge/ uncommitted.
Advance the session from intent to accept, then once more to done.
Check .chough/sessions/archive/: earlier-0.json and earlier-1.json are gone, moved into knowledge/attachments/.
impact: Silent loss of committed archived session records in adopter projects; blocks 0.6.0's keep-all archive (KNOW-34).
source: GitHub issue #165; algochat repro 2026-11-10; red regression run in plan step 1

notes.text: status: open -> verified. Fixed by plan step 3 (PR #238): sessions finish into one story under .chough/archive/sessions/ and there is no roll-up, so the move into done leaves every earlier story in place. TC-history-165-earlier-archives-stay passed on local-macos-arm64 with the test unignored.
